checkpoints.description: [1/3] Make a blocked profile save read-only: no unpersisted freeze, first-clear or lifetime claims

impact_assessment.why: With a future-format afterimage.profile, a perfect daily win says Streak freeze earned and First Daily clear, updates in-memory freezes/runs/wins, but the raw file is untouched; reload loses all of it
impact_assessment.benefits: A blocked profile cannot mint or announce freezes/clears, and the future save stays byte-identical; the daily save (writable) still records its own result
impact_assessment.risks: contract: profile mutations and claims are gated on the profile key, daily/bests unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: blocked profile remains defaults in memory
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing earnFreeze blocked test; same future-profile perfect daily win before/after screenshots; reload/raw checks; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Blocked profile guards, perfect-daily freeze/first-clear check, cache v28 and freeze-audit dead end verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle24-blocked-profile' completed successfully.
[1/3] Add a visible seconds readout and live accessible value to the timer bar

impact_assessment.why: The only clock is a 3px bar with aria-label 'Time remaining' and no value; players cannot read exact seconds and screen readers cannot hear the remaining time
impact_assessment.benefits: A right-aligned 12s-style readout updates once per second, and the timer's aria-label carries the current value for assistive tech
impact_assessment.risks: contract: timer visual/ARIA only, no timing/score changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: data-time updated only when the whole second changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing timerLabel and shell contract tests; same Focus 12s crop before/after; played run checks 12s-to-11s and a wrong-pick life loss; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Timer readout/ARIA, same-12s crop pair, 12-to-11s played check, cache v29 and gates verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle25-timer-label' completed successfully.
[1/3] Give the Focus lives dots a visible count and an accessible N-of-M label

impact_assessment.why: The lives HUD is three unlabeled dots: sighted players must count them and assistive tech gets only the word Focus, with no lives value
impact_assessment.benefits: A visible numeric count sits beside the dots, and the dots expose '2 of 3 focus remaining' through ARIA, updating after every loss
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD value/ARIA only, no lives logic/timing changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no persistence changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing livesLabel and shell contract tests; same HUD crop before/after and after a wrong pick; played wrong-pick run; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Lives count/ARIA, HUD crop pair, 3-to-2 wrong-pick run, cache v30 and gates verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle26-lives-text' completed successfully.
[1/3] Restore the Streak label on narrow HUDs so the bare trailing number is legible

impact_assessment.why: At 390x844 the HUD hides the Streak label and leaves a bare 0 at the far right; after adding the lives count, players cannot tell what that number means
impact_assessment.benefits: The mobile HUD carries Mode, Level, Score, Focus and Streak labels consistently; the 390/320 layouts still fit with stressed score/streak values
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CSS breakpoint only, no HUD logic changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing mobile CSS contract; same 390 HUD crop before/after; 320 stress fit measurement; keyboard/pointer played run clearing a board; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Mobile streak label, 390/320 fit stress, Focus clear played run, cache v31 and gates verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle27-streak-label' completed successfully.
[1/3] Restore the Focus lives label on narrow HUDs so every value is labelled

impact_assessment.why: At 390x844 the lives block is dots + 3 with no Focus label, while Mode, Level, Score and Streak all keep labels; the last unlabeled HUD value is ambiguous
impact_assessment.benefits: All five HUD values are labelled at 390/320; removing the hide adds no horizontal width because the dots+count already exceed the label
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one narrow-screen CSS rule, no HUD logic/state changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing mobile CSS contract; same 390 HUD before/after; 320/390 stress fit; played Focus clear; full gates

[1/3] Make the game shell inert while the menu/result dialog is open

impact_assessment.why: The accessibility tree still exposes the background brand link, SOUND ON and status line while the modal veil is open; screen-reader browse mode can leave the dialog even though keyboard Tab is trapped
impact_assessment.benefits: The modal is isolated in the accessibility tree as well as the keyboard; background controls disappear while menu/result is open and return for play
impact_assessment.risks: contract: shell inert/aria-hidden toggling only, no layout/state changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing shell contract; AX tree before/after (background names absent); menu/result/play inert-state logs; visual parity screenshots; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Shell inert/aria-hidden, AX menu/result isolation, play restore, visual parity, cache v33 and layout dead end verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle29-shell-inert' completed successfully.
[1/1] Audit the cold-start and steady 10x10 Nightmare loop for frame/long-task defects; change only if reproduced

impact_assessment.why: The final Nightmare board renders 100 tiles with per-frame gradients; a cold-start or steady-state frame-health defect would hurt the hardest mode
impact_assessment.benefits: Either a reproduced perf defect with a measurable fix, or a documented clean budget that closes the continuous improvement loop
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no change unless a defect reproduces; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Measure cold start, board-ready time, 2.5s rAF intervals, long tasks and Performance metrics; preserve the board screenshot; full gates

checkpoints.description: [1/1] 10x10 Nightmare audit: 60fps, no long tasks, cold start 383ms; zero verified improvements, no code change (checklists: passed)
